description: The top floor of the tower, which has turned almost a quarter-turn on its way up, so every window looks down a diagonal of the street grid. Fourteen tables. A bar along the core. A small kitchen behind the lift.

window.description: The whole perimeter, canted off the grid by the twist, so no window frames a street square-on. The Basin to the north, the Curtain to the south, and between them the quarter with its lights on in the wrong places.
window.name: the crown glazing

name: Top of the Market — The Crown Floor
